title: Refund policy
body: Full refund within 14 days of delivery for unused items. Damaged-on-arrival items: full refund or replacement within 30 days, photo required. Refunds over 1,000 ILS need supervisor approval.

title: Damaged item on arrival
body: Ask for a photo of the damage and the packaging. Offer replacement first; refund if the customer prefers. The customer does not need to return items worth under 200 ILS.

title: Keeping the item after a refund
body: Customers may keep a damaged item only if its value is under 200 ILS. Otherwise a free return label is sent.

title: Delivery times
body: Israel: 2-5 business days. Europe: 5-10 business days. US: 7-14 business days.

title: Lost package
body: If tracking shows no movement for 7 days, open a carrier investigation. After 14 days, offer a replacement or refund.

title: Change delivery address
body: Possible only while the order status is processing.

title: Double charge
body: Verify both charges in the payment system. Duplicate charges are reversed within 3-5 business days. Priority high.

title: Invoices
body: Invoices are emailed on shipment. A copy can be resent from the order page.

title: Product not working
body: Run basic troubleshooting from the product manual. Within 12 months: warranty replacement. Smart devices: check firmware first.

title: Warranty
body: All products have a 12-month manufacturer warranty. Platinum customers get 24 months.

title: Cannot log in
body: Send a password reset link. After 3 failed resets, verify identity and escalate to the account team.

title: Change email address
body: Requires identity verification: confirm order number and last 4 digits of the payment card.

title: Cancel subscription
body: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing month. Partial-month refunds only for gold and platinum tiers.

title: Escalation
body: Escalate to a human for: legal threats, safety issues, refunds over 1,000 ILS, or any request to bypass policy.
